prodinfo.prodname: X-Author Chatter on Salesforce Winter 2018 Integration Guide

conbody.p: Collaborating on PowerPoint files enables content to be shared from the text level, up to the entire presentation.

If you only want to share an image, it is best to share the entire slide containing the image, to retain its original properties. Just sharing an image in Chatter uploads it to the feed as a png file which may not be the same quality as the original.
